s1.desc: a snowy yard in front of a round ice-block igloo with a wooden door, with pine trees on the hills behind

s2.desc: the driver's seat of a red open-top car parked among snowy hills

beats.text: Polly glides the red car on skis up beside the igloo while Pax waits at the door holding his briefcase
Polly stops the car and turns in her seat to climb out while Pax watches

spans.notes: clouds drift slowly; igloo and trees locked. Polly sits in the car, lower body hidden by it

static, Polly walks in with bags, hands Pax the keys and kisses him (hearts). The keys hang on a keychain with a small Polly figure and a strap reading her name, visible in Polly's or Pax's flipper from about f40 to f87. Dropped conservatively as a lead copy; otherwise a good two-lead span

spans.view: with the dashboard and steering wheel in front of him and pine trees on the hills behind

beats.text: Pax sits squeezed into the driver's seat and pulls the car door shut beside him
Pax squirms with his eyes squeezed shut, pressed up against the steering wheel
Pax leans over to his side and peers down beside the seat with a worried look
Pax sits up, reaches back with a flipper and shoves the seat backward
